title: LLM-REVal: Can We Trust LLM Reviewers Yet?

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating a multi-round peer review process to compare review scores of LLM-authored versus human-authored papers, and correlating the scores with specific linguistic features such as text length, lexical diversity (n-grams), and syntactic complexity (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, dependency distance).

Using keyword-based detection to identify negative or critical terms (e.g., bias, risk, failure) in paper abstracts, computing their sentiment polarity, and analyzing the correlation between the frequency of these keywords and the review scores assigned by the LLM.
